summary: Per second on allocated memory while active, CPU included; standby bills storage only.

egress.note: Listed as included on the pricing table.

notes: Standby keeps a snapshot, billed at $0.20 per GB-month; its size is not published, so it is not added.
Up to $200 of promotional credit is advertised; the actual grant is not published.

CPU is not chosen separately: Blaxel gives 4 cores with 8 GB of memory and 6 with 16 GB. More than 4 cores is billed at 16 GB; more than 6 is not documented. Core counts for smaller memory sizes are not published, so smaller requests are billed at the memory asked for.

upkeep.label: What you keep up
upkeep.detail: You build the image from your own Dockerfile, and Blaxel tells you to keep base images updated; pushing a new image does not change existing sandboxes. Patching a running sandbox is not published.
